name: iNaturalist 2021 Competition Dataset
description: A premier fine-grained biodiversity dataset curated by Caltech, Cornell Tech, and the iNaturalist community for the FGVC8 workshop at CVPR 2021. Features 10,000 species of organisms from across the tree of life (plants, insects, birds, mammals, fungi, reptiles, amphibians, and mollusks). Contains over 2.7 million images in total, including a carefully curated mini-split with 50 training images per class to benchmark balanced fine-grained visual classification at extreme taxonomy scale.
